question: Grove avocado oil brand company owner
markdown:
Grove Avocado Oil
is a privately owned New Zealand company based in Te Puna, Bay of Plenty. It was established around 2000 by
a cooperative group of local avocado orchardists
. Long-time leader and board member Brian Richardson has served as its director and executive head, while Liz Muller serves as the chief executive officer.
